name: Relevance
description: Measures how relevant the response is to the context and the conversation flow.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates how well the response encourages further conversation and interaction.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and creativity of the response.

name: Accuracy
description: Determines the factual accuracy of the response, especially if it includes specific information.

name: Contextual Appropriateness
description: Measures how well the response fits the context and tone of the conversation.
